blocks.text: Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'llar: give me the book

Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin ikkita to'ldiruvchi keladi: **narsa** (nimani?) va **kishi** (kimga?). O'zbekchada kishi `-ga`, narsa `-ni` qo'shimchasini oladi, shuning uchun tartib erkin: «**Menga** kitob**ni** ber» = «Kitob**ni** **menga** ber». Ingliz tilida qo'shimcha yo'q, shuning uchun ikkita qat'iy tuzilish bor. **A**: fe'l + **kishi** + narsa — Give **me** the book (**to** yo'q!). **B**: fe'l + narsa + **to** + kishi — Give the book **to me**.

rows: She sent a postcard **to her mum**.

blocks.text: Qaysi birini tanlash kerak? Ot bilan ikkalasi ham to'g'ri. Ingliz tilida eng muhim yoki yangi ma'lumot odatda gap **oxiriga** qo'yiladi: «nima berdingiz?» degan savolga — I gave Aziz **the money**; «kimga berdingiz?» degan savolga — I gave the money **to Aziz**. Asosiysi: A tuzilishda kishidan oldin **to** qo'yilmaydi. «Give to me the book» — o'zbekcha `-ga` ta'sirida chiqadigan eng ko'p xato.

items.text: We sent an invitation **to all our friends**.

blocks.text: Narsa it / them bo'lsa: give it to me

Narsa olmosh bo'lsa (**it**, **them**), deyarli doim B tuzilish ishlatiladi: olmosh fe'ldan keyin darhol keladi, kishi esa **to** bilan oxirda: **Give it to me.** I sent **them to** my sister. Show **it to** him. Kishi ham olmosh bo'lsa ham shunday: give **it to her**. Britaniyaning so'zlashuv tilida «Give me it» ham eshitiladi, lekin o'rganuvchi uchun to'g'ri va xavfsiz shakl — **give it to me**.

rows: Give **me the book**. / Give the book **to me**.
I sent to Madina a letter.
I sent **Madina a letter**. / I sent a letter **to Madina**.

items.text: Where's my phone? **Give it to me**, please.
I've got the photos. I'll **send them to you** tonight.
items.translation: Suratlar menda. Bugun kechqurun **ularni sizga yuboraman**.

blocks.text: buy, get, make, cook — for bilan

Ba'zi fe'llarda B tuzilish **to** bilan emas, **for** bilan quriladi: **buy, get, make, cook, find, book**. I bought **my mother** flowers = I bought flowers **for my mother**. Mantiq oddiy: **to** — narsa kishiga **o'tadi** (give, send, show); **for** — ish kishi **uchun** qilinadi (buy, make, cook). O'zbekchada ham ko'pincha «onam **uchun** gul oldim» yoki «onam**ga** gul olib berdim». it / them bilan: I bought **it for** her.
explain, say, describe — faqat to bilan

Ayrim fe'llar A tuzilishni **umuman qabul qilmaydi**: **explain, say, describe, suggest, introduce**. Kishi faqat **to** bilan keladi: Explain the rule **to me** («Explain me the rule» — xato). O'zbekcha «menga tushuntiring» aynan shu xatoga olib keladi. **say** va **tell** farqi ham shu yerda: **tell me** (to yo'q), lekin **say to me**: What did he **say to you**? = What did he **tell you**? (→ 50-dars).

items.text: Could you **explain the problem to me**?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Give to me the book.» → **Give me the book.**; «Give me it.» → **Give it to me.**; «Explain me this word.» → **Explain this word to me.**; «He said me the truth.» → **He told me the truth.**; «I bought to my mother flowers.» → **I bought my mother flowers.** / **I bought flowers for my mother.**; «Can you lend to me your car?» → **Can you lend me your car?**

Eslab qolish: kishi fe'ldan keyin **darhol** kelsa — **to yo'q** (give **me**). Kishi oxirda kelsa — **to** yoki **for** (give it **to me**, buy it **for me**). **it** va **them** doim fe'ldan keyin darhol keladi.
Bog'lanish: me, him, them — 59-dars; fe'l + to'ldiruvchi tartibi — 93-dars; say va tell — 50-dars; maqsad bildiruvchi for — 54-dars.

rows: Give **it to me**. Send **them to her**.

examples.title: **give** / **lend** + person + thing
examples.description: A tuzilish: fe'l + kishi + narsa — give **me** your number, lend **his sister** his car. Kishidan oldin **to** qo'yilmaydi.

sentences.text: Can you **give me** your phone number?
sentences.translation: Telefon raqamingizni **menga bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: My uncle **gave Aziz** a watch for his birthday.
sentences.translation: Amakim tug'ilgan kuniga **Azizga** soat **sovg'a qildi**.

sentences.text: Could you **lend me** fifty pounds until payday?
sentences.translation: Maosh olgunimcha **menga** ellik funt **qarz berib tura olasizmi**?

sentences.text: The doctor **gave Madina** some tablets for her headache.
sentences.translation: Shifokor bosh og'rig'i uchun **Madinaga** dori **berdi**.

sentences.text: James **lent his sister** his car for the weekend.
sentences.translation: Jeyms dam olish kunlariga **singlisiga** mashinasini **berib turdi**.

sentences.text: **Give the dog** some water — it's very hot today.
sentences.translation: **Itga** suv **bering** — bugun juda issiq.

sentences.text: We **gave our neighbours** a box of sweets for Navruz.
sentences.translation: Navro'zda **qo'shnilarimizga** bir quti shirinlik **hadya qildik**.

sentences.text: Sarah never **lends anyone** her books.
sentences.translation: Sara kitoblarini **hech kimga** o'qishga **bermaydi**.

sentences.text: Who **gave you** this beautiful scarf?
sentences.translation: Bu chiroyli sharfni **sizga** kim **berdi**?

sentences.text: When I was a student, my grandmother **gave me** fifty dollars every month.
sentences.translation: Talabalik paytimda buvim **menga** har oy ellik dollar **berardi**.

examples.title: **send**, **show**, **bring**, **pass** + person + thing
examples.description: A tuzilishdagi boshqa fe'llar: send **me**, show **us**, pass **me**, bring **us**, tell **me**, pay **the driver**, offer **us**.

sentences.text: Please **send me** the photos from the wedding.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, to'y suratlarini **menga yuboring**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **showed us** her new flat yesterday.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kecha **bizga** yangi kvartirasini **ko'rsatdi**.

sentences.text: Could you **pass me** the bread, please?
sentences.translation: Nonni **uzatib yuborasizmi**, iltimos?

sentences.text: The waiter **brought us** the menu and two glasses of water.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant **bizga** menyu va ikki stakan suv **olib keldi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **told me** a funny story about his army days.
sentences.translation: Bobom **menga** armiyadagi kunlari haqida kulgili voqea **aytib berdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **sends his mother** flowers every Mother's Day.
sentences.translation: Tom har yili Onalar kunida **onasiga** gul **yuboradi**.

sentences.text: Can you **show me** how this machine works?
sentences.translation: Bu mashina qanday ishlashini **menga ko'rsata olasizmi**?

sentences.text: **Bring me** a glass of water, please — I'm so thirsty.
sentences.translation: **Menga** bir stakan suv **olib keling**, iltimos — juda chanqadim.

sentences.text: Aziz **paid the taxi driver** fifty thousand som.
sentences.translation: Aziz **taksi haydovchisiga** ellik ming so'm **to'ladi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbour **offered us** tea, but we were in a hurry.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimiz **bizga** choy **taklif qildi**, lekin biz shoshayotgan edik.

examples.title: Thing + **to** + person: give the money **to Aziz**
examples.description: B tuzilish: fe'l + narsa + **to** + kishi. Kishi yangi, muhim yoki uzun bo'lsa, u gap oxiriga qo'yiladi.

sentences.text: I gave the money **to Aziz**, not to his brother.
sentences.translation: Pulni **Azizga** berdim, akasiga emas.

sentences.text: Please send this letter **to the manager** today.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, bu xatni bugun **menejerga** yuboring.

sentences.text: Madina showed her wedding photos **to all her colleagues**.
sentences.translation: Madina to'y suratlarini **barcha hamkasblariga** ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: We sold our old car **to a young couple from Namangan**.
sentences.translation: Eski mashinamizni **Namanganlik yosh oilaga** sotdik.

sentences.text: Who did you lend your dictionary **to**?
sentences.translation: Lug'atingizni **kimga** berib turdingiz?

sentences.text: Can you pass this message **to Sarah** when she comes in?
sentences.translation: Sara kelganda, bu xabarni **unga** yetkazib qo'ya olasizmi?

sentences.text: The museum gives free tickets **to students and teachers**.
sentences.translation: Muzey **talabalar va o'qituvchilarga** bepul chipta beradi.

sentences.text: Tom wrote a long email **to his old school friend**.
sentences.translation: Tom **maktabdagi eski do'stiga** uzun xat yozdi.

sentences.text: Grandma always tells the same stories **to every guest**.
sentences.translation: Buvim **har bir mehmonga** doim bir xil hikoyalarni aytib beradi.

sentences.text: Bekzod explained the problem **to the engineer** on the phone.
sentences.translation: Bekzod muammoni telefonda **muhandisga** tushuntirdi.

examples.title: **it** / **them**: give **it to me**
examples.description: Narsa **it** yoki **them** bo'lsa — B tuzilish: give **it to me**, sent **them to her**. Olmosh fe'ldan keyin darhol keladi.

sentences.text: That's my pen! **Give it to me**!
sentences.translation: Bu mening ruchkam! **Uni menga ber**!

sentences.text: I've finished the book, so I'll **give it back to you** tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Kitobni o'qib bo'ldim, ertaga **uni sizga qaytarib beraman**.

sentences.text: These are Madina's keys. Can you **give them to her**?
sentences.translation: Bu Madinaning kalitlari. **Ularni unga berib qo'ya olasizmi**?

sentences.text: I wrote a postcard and **sent it to my grandmother** from London.
sentences.translation: Otkritka yozib, **uni** Londondan **buvimga yubordim**.

sentences.text: Where are the photos? — I **showed them to Dad** last night.
sentences.translation: Suratlar qayerda? — Kecha kechqurun **ularni dadamga ko'rsatdim**.

sentences.text: Aziz needed a laptop, so I **lent mine to him**.
sentences.translation: Azizga noutbuk kerak edi, shuning uchun **menikini unga berib turdim**.

sentences.text: If you don't want these old clothes, **give them to a charity shop**.
sentences.translation: Bu eski kiyimlar sizga kerak bo'lmasa, **ularni xayriya do'koniga topshiring**.

sentences.text: The bank made a new card for me, but they **sent it to my old address**.
sentences.translation: Bank menga yangi karta tayyorladi, lekin **uni eski manzilimga yuboribdi**.

sentences.text: Did you give Tom his present? — Yes, I **gave it to him** this morning.
sentences.translation: Tomga sovg'asini berdingizmi? — Ha, bugun ertalab **uni unga berdim**.

sentences.text: Sarah found a wallet in the street and **took it to the police**.
sentences.translation: Sara ko'chada hamyon topib oldi va **uni politsiyaga olib bordi**.

examples.title: **buy**, **make**, **cook** + **for**
examples.description: buy, get, make, cook, find, book — B tuzilishda **for** bilan: bought it **for Lola**. A tuzilish ham bor: bought **her son** a bike.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **bought her son** a new bike for his birthday.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **o'g'liga** tug'ilgan kuniga yangi velosiped **olib berdi**.

sentences.text: I **made a cake for Grandma** because it was her birthday.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuni bo'lgani uchun **buvim uchun** tort **pishirdim**.

sentences.text: Could you **get me** a coffee from the machine?
sentences.translation: Avtomatdan **menga** bitta qahva **olib kela olasizmi**?

sentences.text: My husband **cooked dinner for the whole family** on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni erim **butun oila uchun** kechki ovqat **pishirdi**.

sentences.text: We've **booked a table for six people** at the restaurant.
sentences.translation: Restoranda **olti kishi uchun** stol **band qildik**.

sentences.text: James **found his sister** a cheap flat near the university.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **singlisiga** universitet yaqinidan arzon kvartira **topib berdi**.

sentences.text: I saw a lovely scarf and **bought it for Lola**.
sentences.translation: Chiroyli sharf ko'rib, **uni Lolaga olib berdim**.

sentences.text: Shall I **make you** a sandwich? — Yes, please, I'm starving.
sentences.translation: **Sizga** sendvich **tayyorlab beraymi**? — Ha, iltimos, qornim juda och.

sentences.text: The children **made a card for their teacher** on Teachers' Day.
sentences.translation: Bolalar O'qituvchilar kunida **o'qituvchisi uchun** tabriknoma **yasashdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz didn't have time to buy lunch, so I **got some sandwiches for him**.
sentences.translation: Azizning tushlik olishga vaqti yo'q edi, shuning uchun **unga** sendvich **olib keldim**.

examples.title: **explain**, **say**, **describe**: only with **to**
examples.description: Bu fe'llarda A tuzilish yo'q — kishi faqat **to** bilan: explain it **to me**, say something **to Mum**. tell esa to siz: **tell me**.

sentences.text: Can you **explain this rule to me**?
sentences.translation: Bu qoidani **menga tushuntira olasizmi**?

sentences.text: The teacher **explained the homework to the class** twice.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi uy vazifasini **sinfga** ikki marta **tushuntirdi**.

sentences.text: What did the doctor **say to you**?
sentences.translation: Shifokor **sizga** nima **dedi**?

sentences.text: Could you **describe the thief to the police**?
sentences.translation: **O'g'rining** tashqi ko'rinishini **politsiyaga ta'riflab bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Madina **told me** the news, but she didn't **say** anything **to her husband**.
sentences.translation: Madina yangilikni **menga aytdi**, lekin **eriga** hech narsa **demadi**.

sentences.text: Please **explain to me** why you're late again.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, nega yana kechikkaningizni **menga tushuntiring**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **suggested a good restaurant to us**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **bizga** yaxshi bir restoranni **tavsiya qildi**.

sentences.text: Don't **say** a word **to Mum** about the party!
sentences.translation: Ziyofat haqida **oyimga** bir og'iz ham **gapirma**!

sentences.text: Tom **introduced his girlfriend to his parents** at dinner.
sentences.translation: Tom kechki ovqatda **qiz do'stini ota-onasi bilan tanishtirdi**.

sentences.text: I tried to **explain the situation to my boss**, but he didn't listen.
sentences.translation: **Boshlig'imga** vaziyatni **tushuntirishga** harakat qildim, lekin u quloq solmadi.

examples.title: Questions and answers: Did you give **it to him**?
examples.description: Savol → javob. Savolda ko'pincha ot (the keys), javobda esa olmosh — demak B tuzilish: I gave **them to him**.

sentences.text: Did you give Aziz the keys? — Yes, I **gave them to him** at lunch.
sentences.translation: Azizga kalitlarni berdingizmi? — Ha, tushlikda **ularni unga berdim**.

sentences.text: Who **sent you** these roses? — I don't know; there's no card.
sentences.translation: Bu atirgullarni **sizga** kim **yubordi**? — Bilmayman, tabriknoma yo'q.

sentences.text: Have you shown Madina your new car? — Not yet; I'll **show it to her** tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Madinaga yangi mashinangizni ko'rsatdingizmi? — Hali yo'q, ertaga **uni unga ko'rsataman**.

sentences.text: Can you **lend me** your umbrella? — Sorry, I've already **lent it to Bekzod**.
sentences.translation: **Menga** soyaboningizni **berib tura olasizmi**? — Kechirasiz, uni allaqachon **Bekzodga berib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: What did you buy your dad for his birthday? — I **bought him** a new wallet.
sentences.translation: Dadangizga tug'ilgan kuniga nima oldingiz? — **Unga** yangi hamyon **oldim**.

sentences.text: Where's my book? — I **gave it to your sister**; she wanted to read it.
sentences.translation: Kitobim qayerda? — **Uni opangizga berdim**, o'qimoqchi ekan.

sentences.text: Did they **offer you** the job? — Yes, and I said yes!
sentences.translation: **Sizga** o'sha ishni **taklif qilishdimi**? — Ha, men rozi bo'ldim!

sentences.text: Who did you sell your old flat **to**? — **To** a family from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Eski kvartirangizni **kimga** sotdingiz? — **Samarqandlik** bir oilaga.

sentences.text: Could you **bring me** my glasses? — Of course. Where are they?
sentences.translation: **Menga** ko'zoynagimni **olib kelib bera olasizmi**? — Albatta. Qayerda?

sentences.text: Has Sarah paid back the money? — No, she'll **give it to me** on Friday.
sentences.translation: Sara pulni qaytardimi? — Yo'q, uni juma kuni **menga beradi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: birthday presents
examples.description: Ikki dugona tug'ilgan kun sovg'alari haqida gaplashyapti: give her, give it to her, buy her, lend me, send me.

sentences.text: — What are you going to **give Madina** for her birthday?
sentences.translation: — Tug'ilgan kuniga **Madinaga** nima **sovg'a qilasiz**?

sentences.text: — I've **bought her** a book about Italian cooking.
sentences.translation: — **Unga** italyan oshxonasi haqida kitob **sotib oldim**.

sentences.text: — Nice! Have you **given it to her** yet?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! **Uni unga berdingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Not yet. I'm going to **give it to her** at the party on Saturday.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. Shanba kuni ziyofatda **beraman**.

sentences.text: — Oh, **show me** the book! I'd love to see it.
sentences.translation: — Voy, kitobni **menga ko'rsating**! Ko'rgim kelyapti.

sentences.text: — Sure, here it is. And could you **lend me** some wrapping paper?
sentences.translation: — Albatta, mana. Aytgancha, **menga** biroz o'rash qog'ozi **berib tura olasizmi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. I'll **bring it to you** tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Ertaga ertalab **sizga olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks. And what are you **getting for her**?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Siz-chi, **unga** nima **olyapsiz**?

sentences.text: — I'm **making her** a photo album with pictures from our school days.
sentences.translation: — **Unga** maktab davrimizdagi suratlardan albom **tayyorlayapman**.

sentences.text: — What a lovely idea! Please **send me** a few photos too.
sentences.translation: — Qanday ajoyib fikr! **Menga** ham bir nechta surat **yuboring**.
